text: The Tour of Guangxi is 'officially known as the GREE-Tour of Guangxi for sponsorship purposes', and the race is owned and organised by the People's Government of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region together with Wanda Group (whose owner is Dalian Hexing Investment Co., the Wang family holding of founder Wang Jianlin); the 2026 edition, 13-18 October, closes the UCI WorldTour.
short: GREE titles the state-owned Tour of Guangxi; organisers are the Guangxi government and Wanda
